de:Sehnsucht.gloss_en: an intense, often bittersweet yearning for something distant, lost or unattainable

de:Heimat.gloss_en: home(land) as a place of belonging, identity and emotional attachment, not just residence

de:Fernweh.gloss_en: an ache to be far away, a longing for distant places one has not been to (opposite of homesickness)

de:Weltschmerz.gloss_en: world-weariness; sorrow at the gap between the world as it is and as it should be

de:Gemütlichkeit.gloss_en: cosy, unhurried warmth and conviviality; a state of comfortable belonging

en:serendipity.gloss_en: the happy accident of finding something good without looking for it

en:awkward.gloss_en: socially uncomfortable or embarrassing; clumsy; difficult to handle

en:privacy.gloss_en: the state of being free from being observed or disturbed by others

en:wistful.gloss_en: having a gentle, sad longing, often for something past or unattainable

en:home.gloss_en: the place where one lives or belongs

es:sobremesa.gloss_en: the unhurried time spent talking at the table after a meal

es:duende.gloss_en: (1) goblin, imp; (2) the mysterious power of art to move deeply (Lorca, flamenco)

es:madrugada.gloss_en: the small hours, between midnight and dawn

es:estrenar.gloss_en: to use or wear something for the first time; to premiere (a play or film)

fr:dépaysement.gloss_en: the disorientation (pleasant or not) of being out of one's usual surroundings, especially abroad

fr:flâner.gloss_en: to stroll aimlessly, savouring the city (cf. the flâneur)

fr:retrouvailles.gloss_en: the joy of reuniting with someone after a long separation; a reunion

fr:esprit de l'escalier.gloss_en: thinking of the perfect retort only after the moment has passed (Diderot)

fr:ennui.gloss_en: boredom; (also) worry, trouble; English 'ennui' = listless world-weariness

fr:déjà vu.gloss_en: the feeling of having already experienced the present situation

it:sprezzatura.gloss_en: studied nonchalance; making difficult things look effortless (Castiglione)

it:menefreghismo.gloss_en: a defiant 'I don't give a damn' attitude, studied indifference (from 'me ne frego')

it:abbiocco.gloss_en: (colloquial, central Italy) the drowsiness that comes after a big meal

pt:saudade.gloss_en: an aching longing for someone or something absent, often loved and possibly never to return

pt:cafuné.gloss_en: tenderly running one's fingers through someone's hair (Brazilian Portuguese)

pt:jeitinho.gloss_en: (Brazilian) a clever, informal way round a rule or obstacle, often through charm or personal connections

rom:bbiocca.gloss_en: broody hen (a hen sitting on eggs, with her chicks)

rom:bbona sera.gloss_en: "good evening / good night"; also idiomatic "and that's that, it's all over"

rom:a ppecorone.gloss_en: on all fours, on hands and knees (from pecora, sheep)

rom:ffora a cchi ttoca.gloss_en: "out, whoever's turn it is!" -- a call like "next!", or a summons to come out
